Translation of extract from "China Times" of May 4, 1930.

"Over half a month has elapsed since the workers of the
"China General Omnibus Company went on strike. As both the
"employers and the workers have assumed a firm attitude, the
"men have attempted to extend the strike in order to attract
"the attention of the general public. The employers, however,
"are training substitutes such as "White" Russians with a view
"to rejecting the exhorbitant demands of the workers.
"1. The "White" Russians do not understand the Chinese
"language, and as they are strangers it is doubtful if they
"can perform their duties in an efficient manner, especially
"in a cosmopolitan city like Shanghai. As they have been
"unemployed for a long time and belong to an undesirable class,
"misunderstandings with passengers are likely to occur.
"2. The cost of living for "White" Russians is higher than
"that for Chinese workers. If the scale of pay of the Chinese
"workmen be raised, the management will incur heavier
"responsibilities, whereas if discrimination in favour of the
"Russians is shown, ill-feeling ████ is likely to arise
"amongst the Chinese workers.
"3. The best policy is for capitalists and labourers to
"assume a firm conciliatory attitude but if each side assume
"a firm and obstinate attitude, untoward incidents are likely
"to arise.
"4. Since the slump in silver, people have experienced
"hardship in maintaining their living and the number of
"unemployed workers has increased. If "White" Russians are
"are employed, it amounts to an oppression of Chinese workers
"and great excitement will be created.
"A fundamental solution of the problem is for both parties
"to manifest sincerity, explain its difficulties and assume
"a conciliatory attitude."

“中华汽车公司工人罢工已过去半个多月。由于
“资方和劳方均采取强硬态度，工人们试图扩大罢工范围以引起
“公众的注意。然而，雇主正在培训‘白’俄人等替代人员，旨在
“拒绝工人的过高要求。
“1. ‘白’俄人不懂中文，且身为异乡人，他们能否有效地
“履行职责令人怀疑，尤其是在像上海这样的国际性大都市。由于
“他们长期失业且属于不良阶层，很可能与乘客发生误会。
“2. ‘白’俄人的生活费用高于中国工人。如果提高中国
“工人的工资标准，管理层将承担更重的责任；而如果表现出
“偏向俄国人的歧视，中国工人之间很可能会产生恶感 ████。
“3. 最好的政策是资本家和劳工采取坚定的和解态度，但
“如果双方都采取坚定且顽固的态度，则可能会发生不幸事件。
“4. 自从银价暴跌以来，人们维持生计变得艰难，失业
“工人数量增加。如果雇用‘白’俄人，这就等于压迫中国工人，
“并将引发巨大的骚动。
“解决这一问题的根本办法是双方表现出诚意，说明各自的
“困难，并采取和解态度。”

THE SHOWDOWN Shanghai, 29th April, 1930

THE STRIKE OF THE BUS DRIVERS.

Some months ago it was suggested in the columns of this paper that a special department might be formed in the Municipal Council of the nature of a Labour Department which could take cognizance of labour troubles and disputes in the Settlement, and might act as a useful and sympathetic go-between the differing parties involved.

It still seems to us a desirable innovation, and the recent strike of the drivers of the China General Omnibus Company is a case in point in which such a 'Labour' department might render most useful service to the workmen, to the employers, and to the public alike.

At any rate, it would ensure that the whole circumstances which have led up to the Chinese drivers leaving their jobs and holding up the bus service would be placed before the public, fully and dispassionately.

If the men have legitimate grievances against the circumstances of their employment, these would become known.

On the other hand, if the bus company is treating their men fairly and considerately and their business in being held up by unreasonable or extortionate demands, this also should become known.

The travelling public are concerned in the why's and wherefore's of the strike because of the inconvenience that the enforced stoppage of the buses causes.

There has also been a recent labour trouble in the printing department of our contemporary, the "China Press", and it seems to us that these and kindred labour matters might very well be taken note of by a municipal Labour department with a view to adjusting the differences of the parties involved.

We advocate the formation of such a branch of municipal activities because, very often we feel sure, it would be able to arbitrate and adjust matters without any racial or political feelings being involved, and it could confer benefits on employers and employees alike.

《决断》 上海，1930年4月29日

巴士司机罢工。

几个月前，本报专栏曾建议工部局可设立一个类似劳工部的特别部门，以受理租界内的劳工纠纷和争议，并可在各方之间充当有用且富有同情心的中间人。

在我们看来，这仍然是一项值得推行的革新，最近中华汽车公司司机的罢工就是一个例证，表明此类“劳工”部门可以为工人、雇主以及公众提供极有用的服务。

无论如何，这将确保导致中国司机离职并致使巴士服务停滞的全部情况能够充分且客观地公之于众。

如果工人对其雇佣状况有正当的不满，这些不满将为世人所知。

另一方面，如果巴士公司公平且体贴地对待其员工，而其业务因不合理或勒索性的要求而受阻，这一点也应为人所知。

出行公众关心罢工的前因后果，因为巴士被迫停运造成了不便。

近期，我们的同行《大陆报》（China Press）的印刷部也发生了劳工纠纷，在我们看来，市政劳工部门完全可以关注此类及相关劳工事务，以便调整涉事各方的分歧。

我们主张设立这样一个市政活动分支，因为很多时候我们确信，它能够在不涉及种族或政治情绪的情况下仲裁和调整事务，并能使雇主和雇员双方受益。

Sir,

On the 15th of April, 1930, a deputation of the Bus Drivers presented their demands to Mr. Benner, Manager of the Depot at 43 Connaught Road in which they demanded a flat rate of $4.00 increase, and that the accident bonus of $1.00 be doubled also that the conductors are not fined if they omit to get down from the bus at stopping places, and the rule applied to Drivers be repealed in which they have to stop the engine of the Bus at the terminal for two minutes.

The company granted them an increase of $2.00 on salaries of $20. to $30., and $3.00 on salaries of $30. to $50., but refused to give more or to repeal the orders in regard to Conductors and Bus Drivers, getting down from the bus and drivers stopping engines. These demands contained a three days limit, but on the 18/4/30, they decided to give another days grace.

On the 18/4/30, they were told that their demands would not be met, and after consultation ████ in the Companies premises, gave intimation to Mr. Benner that they would strike on the 19/4/30, which they did, none of the Drivers or Conductors turning up for work.

A Bus which is used to convey the conductors and Drivers from the Eastern district leaves Muirhead Road at 5.30 a.m. every morning, and this bus was stopped at Thibet and Nanking Roads corner, and the Drivers and Conductors who were in the bus all left the bus at this place, a number of Drivers and Conductors who live in Frenchtown meet this bus every morning. No rough play was indulged in. The bus returning to the Depot empty.

At 8 a.m. the 19/4/30, the fitters and inside workers arrived at the Depot by Bus, and commenced their respective jobs.

They limit the drivers a definite time from place to place and they count for a monthly average of correct time.
